subject: Social Media
title: The Apology Video Formula
description: A fast breakdown of The Apology Video Formula for builders.

hook.text: Camera close-up. No makeup. Teary eyes. Title: 'I need to talk to you guys.' You've seen this before.

buildup.text: The influencer apology video became a genre. Same structure: vulnerability display, excuse, promise to change.

discovery.text: Research shows these videos often boost engagement. Scandal + apology creates a content cycle that benefits the creator.

twist.text: Audiences became cynical. They now critique apology videos in real time, scoring sincerity like judges.

climax.text: The format devalued real apologies. When everything looks the same, nothing feels genuine.

punchline.text: The apology became content. Content isn't sorry.

quiz.question: What paradox do influencer apology videos create?
options: They often boost engagement, rewarding the scandal cycle
They cause platforms to ban creators
